chapter: Banjo, piano and his own bands
title: Getting his first banjo and learning to play
summary: A fellow gave him a five-string banjo, he taught himself from a book, and soon bought and sold many banjos.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: What kind of banjo did you have when you first started?

I had a practice. A fellow by the name of Wallace. Wallace gave me that banjo. A five string banjo. And I started to play it and I bought me a book. And I started to play in it. And the fellow knocked on my door and said, Hey man, I need a banjo player for tonight. I said, I don't play no banjo. He said, Oh yeah, you do. I said, I don't. So, he said, Let me see that banjo you got. I said, I showed it to him. He said, Man, come on and play. Make this little change. So, after I played him, I went to World Islands and I bought me a banjo from the Sporey's. You know, the Sporey's. I bought a banjo from him. I bought it and played $35 worth. A little wonder. And I began to play it and play it and play it. You know what I mean? I kept on playing until I got me one. Man, I bought so many banjos and sold them, you know. I went to a doctor, a friend of mine. He's a doctor. I said, Listen, I got a nice banjo I'd like to sell you. He said, Let me see it. I said, I got it here right now. I showed it to him. He said, How much do you want for it? I said, That's why not. I said, Wrap it up. He said, Give it to me. He said, That's why not. He told me, Wherever you, you know, get a banjo, save it from me. I'll buy it from you. I said, Okay. And that time I had three banjos. So, I sold him that one. I was always on the market of buying one. You know, I bought this banjo. I was on the street. I said, Shaw Street, somewhere. I'm not wearing it. But I've not been here in about 40 years. Well, you took me a little stroll, eh? Yeah, I think I'll get out of here. Okay, see you later. There's a lot of other fellas that I played with. I just forgot who they are.
